prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: one SkillPilot learning-goal orientation illustration, new PNG, landscape 16:9 about1600x900 or close native size. Friendly abstract hand-drawn comic illustration with bold clean dark blue outlines, softly colored pale blue/green/yellow shapes and cream backdrop, welcoming and scientifically clear. Not a photo, not a sterile technical schematic. One spacious coherent scene, large main objects, readable at 360px phone width and680px desktop; very little text, every necessary label large and exact. No tiny legends, no solved task, no scoring/QA metadata, no claim of a performed experiment. Notes and instruments correctly oriented for the depicted user.

Primary request: illustrate planning and comparing yeast fermentation conditions. Show two identical large closed fermentation vessels side by side, equally filled with sugar solution and yeast, each properly connected by a gas-tight stopper and short tube to its own large gas collector; same apparatus and liquid amount, different controlled water-bath temperatures. Both water baths have their own large thermometer. Label baths exactly "20 °C" and "30 °C" and the collected gas exactly "CO₂". Subtle same-size sugar and yeast icons between the vessels emphasize equal starting conditions. Keep oxygen out of the vessels: sealed stoppers with only proper gas-collection tubing, no air intake, no flame or flask open to air, no extra reactants. A small standalone magnifying-glass icon over a simple ethanol-test strip represents verifying fermentation, no invented result numbers. The scene shows a planned comparison, not a real completed experiment. Avoid balloon-only outcome claims or implying CO2 alone proves fermentation. Do not draw a person or written notebook. Text only the three specified labels. Apparatus must be scientifically coherent and easy to distinguish.

Whole current goal context: Fachpraktische Stoffwechselarbeit. Die lernende Person kann Experimente zu Gärbedingungen planen und auswerten.
